item.title: Denial of service and source code exposure in React Server Components
item.description:
📝 BlogDenial of Service and Source Code Exposure in React Server ComponentsDecember 11, 2025 by The React Team Security researchers have found and disclosed two additional vulnerabilities in React Server Components while attempting to exploit the patches in last week’s critical vulnerability. React Native For React Native users not using a monorepo or react-dom, your react version should be pinned in your package. Even if your app does not implement any React Server Function endpoints it may still be vulnerable if your app supports React Server Components.
🔗 Read more: https://react.dev/blog/2025/12/11/denial-of-service-and-source-code-exposure-in-react-server-components

item.title: My productivity app is a never-ending .txt file (2020)
item.description:
